scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @giftqr/shared" "npm run dev -w @giftqr/server" "npm run dev -w @giftqr/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @giftqr/shared && npm run build -w @giftqr/server && npm run build -w @giftqr/client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @giftqr/server" "npm run start -w @giftqr/client"
